title: Iran's FM Spox. Esmaeil Baqaei on the opening of a maritime transit route with Oman:
text:
Iran's FM Spox. Esmaeil Baqaei on the opening of a maritime transit route with Oman:"

"The development of a maritime transit route with Oman has become time-consuming due to the security complexities stemming from U.S. and Israeli actions."

"Despite this, intensive Iran-Oman negotiations continue to finalize a joint statement and establish a secure mechanism protecting their mutual interests."
